name: Lens Life ~After Story~
source:
When you meet with your favorite classmate and accidentally find that you live in the same building, you want to enjoy the day and night together, but accidentally found the strange secret happened to her, you have to make your own choice!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1510650/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
当你与最喜欢的同学相遇，意外发现彼此住在同一栋楼时，你原本只想和她一起享受朝夕相处的时光，却又偶然发现她身上发生的奇异秘密。你必须做出自己的选择！

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1510650/]Steam[/url]]
